{"metadata":{"description":"Every skill you already have — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI — works in DSH: Agent Skills SKILL.md discovery, Tier-2 conversions, find_skill search, and a skills doctor","id":"gh:1333350638","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-skillport","slug":"Jesse-njx/dsh-skillport","topics":["agent-skills","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","skillport","skills"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Every skill you already have — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI — works in DSH: Agent Skills S"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"KILL.md discovery, Tier-2 conversions, find_skill search, and a skills doctor"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-skillport"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Every skill you already have — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI — works in DSH.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"`dsh-skillport` is a DeepSeek Harness plugin bundle that makes DSH the next implementer of the open "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"**Agent Skills** standard (`SKILL.md`). Anthropic released the spec in Dec 2025 and 30+ harnesses re"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ad it (Codex CLI, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot/VS Code, Goose, Windsurf); DSH did not. Skillport impo"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"rts the whole existing ecosystem with **zero migration**: your `.claude/skills/` library, your Curso"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"r rules, your Claude Code slash commands all become DSH skills the moment the plugin loads."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## What you get"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"| Format | Source | How it lands in DSH |"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| Agent Skills `SKILL.md` | `.claude/skills/`, `~/.claude/skills/` (Claude Code) | model-invocable s"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"kills |
| Agent Skills `SKILL.md` | `~/.gemini/antigravity/skills/` (Gemini CLI) | model-invocable s"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"kills |
| Agent Skills `SKILL.md` | `extraPaths` (config) | model-invocable skills |
| Agent Skills "},{"id":"p7s4","text":"`SKILL.md` | `.dsh/skills/`, `.agents/skills/` (+ user roots) | scanned natively by DSH — skillport "},{"id":"p7s5","text":"never double-scans |
| Cursor rules | `.cursor/rules/*.mdc` | converted to model-invocable skills (s"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"ource `cursor`) |
| Claude Code commands | `.claude/commands/*.md` | converted to **user-invokable**"},{"id":"p7s7","text":" skills (`/name`) |
| Context files | `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` | injected as project context **only "},{"id":"p7s8","text":"if** DSH does not already (native `dsh-agent-instructions` wins — no double-injection) |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Skills flow into the native skill registry (`ctx.skills`), so the platform's own catalog injection, "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"progressive-disclosure index, and the `skill` loader tool surface them automatically. **Registration"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"s are Cordis effects: `dsh plugin remove @dsh-skillport/bundle` unloads every imported skill cleanly"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"** — a live demo of the platform's teardown model."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Why this shape"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"DSH already ships a full skill stack: a provider registry with rank-based dedup, catalog injection ("},{"id":"p10s2","text":"names + descriptions in the system prompt), and a `skill` tool that loads bodies and resolves bundle"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"d file paths. Skillport's job is narrower and honest: **discover the locations DSH does not cover, c"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"onvert the adjacent formats, and make the result debuggable.** That is exactly the spec's "check fir"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"st — don't double-inject" instruction applied to the whole surface:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- `.dsh/skills` + `.agents/skills` are scanned by DSH's native `dsh-skill-filesystem`; skillport det"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"ects that provider and skips those sets (falling back to scanning them itself only when the native p"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"rovider is absent, so the full table holds in any composition).
- The spec's "injection" (names + de"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"scriptions) and "use_skill" (load body + resolve resources) are the native `dsh-tool-skill` catalog "},{"id":"p11s5","text":"and `skill` tool — skillport feeds them, it does not duplicate them.
- `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md` are i"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"njected natively by `dsh-agent-instructions`; skillport takes over only when that plugin is absent."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Then in a session: ask the model to load a skill you used to own in Claude Code — the catalog lists "},{"id":"p14s2","text":"it and the `skill` tool loads it, bundled resources included."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Config"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"All fields optional (profile patch or `cordis.patch.yml`):"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Skills doctor"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Trigger-quality is the fuzzy failure mode: skills tuned for Claude's triggering habits may fire diff"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"erently on DeepSeek models. Skillport pins the revision it implements — see docs"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"/spec-revision.md — and ships a conformance fixture suite (missing fields, unicode names, nested res"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"ources) so spec drift fails loudly in CI."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Non-goals (deliberately)"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- **Claude Code plugins / hooks / subagents** — executable host-specific semantics; porting prose-an"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"d-scripts is honest, pretending to port hook systems is a bug factory.
- **MCP config translation** "},{"id":"p27s3","text":"— out of scope.
- **Codex / Cursor extension binaries** — out of scope.
- Skillport never gets its o"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"wn execution path: skills that carry scripts run through DSH's normal shell tool inside its sandbox,"},{"id":"p27s5","text":" so the sandbox policy stays the single enforcement point."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"Fixtures: `test/fixtures/` holds one skill per source format, conformance edge cases, and the checke"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"d-in goldens for the injected index + doctor report."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
